title: Case study of developing a three agent system for playing a game of tic tac toe.
summary: As artificial intelligence architectures transition from isolated single-agent frameworks to collaborative multi-agent systems (MAS), understanding agent-to-agent orchestration, communication protocols, and turn management becomes critical. This case study documents the design, implementation, and execution of a three-agent system built within the Google Antigravity CLI environment to simulate a competitive game of Tic-Tac-Toe.
